grupos.reason: The comment only flags a misleading component name versus file/usage; nothing breaks or returns wrong results if it is ignored, so it is a naming/style nit.

The comment accurately identifies a concrete bug: the assertion always passes because isChecked() returns a Promise, so the test silently stops verifying that 2FA was enabled, producing a misleading false-positive result rather than being a mere test-coverage nit.

The comment asks for a stronger test assertion (checking clipboard content instead of only the toast), which is a test-coverage request that doesn't affect production behavior, so it fits the definition of a nit.

The comment names a concrete producer/validator mismatch (lowercase hex codes vs. a case-sensitive indexOf), so uppercase backup-code input is wrongly rejected — a described failure, not a speculative nit.
